FOOTER.p: Discover more simple and intuitive tools on our platform

1.p-1: If you don't understand something, try searching on the web. If you can't find the answer, ask us through our customer support (question mark icon in the top menu).
1.h-2: How can you provide feedback to improve the site?
1.p-2: Click the question mark in the menu and write what's on your mind, or what you would change or do differently - we'll be grateful.
1.h-3: Why use calculators on this site?
1.p-3: They were programmed by someone who initially didn't understand taxes and tried to comprehend them, therefore ensuring they are simple and their output calculations are understandable even for beginners.

2.h-1: Why are several functions in the "coming soon" phase?
2.p-1: The reason is that only one developer is working on the development in their spare time, trying to deliver fully functional and tested features, which takes time.
2.p-2: We would like to add articles explaining finance and tax concepts, helping ordinary people better understand these topics without extensive studying. Future plans include guides on how to start with cryptocurrencies, integrating crypto wallet connections to our platform, and much more.
2.h-3: Who could benefit from the calculator along with the information provided on the site?
2.p-3: Everyone. Whether you want to compare salary conditions against the average wage, or see the difference between employee and self-employed income. If you're interested in finance or would like to expand your knowledge.

item1.title: Don't understand something?
item1.content: If you don't understand something, try searching on the web. If you can't find an answer, ask us through our customer support (question mark icon in the top menu).

item2.title: How can you provide feedback to improve the site?
item2.content: Click on the question mark in the menu and write what's on your mind, or what you would change or do differently. We'll appreciate it.

item3.title: Why use calculators on this site?
item3.content: They were programmed by someone who wasn't familiar with taxes and tried to understand them, so they made sure they were simple and that even a layperson could understand the calculation output.

item1.title: Why are several functions in the "coming soon" phase?
item1.content: The reason is that only one developer is working on the development in their free time, and they try to deliver fully functional and tested features, which takes time.

item2.title: What are we planning for the future?
item2.content: We would like to add articles over time that would explain things from the world of finance and taxes so that an ordinary person can better navigate them without extensive studying. In the future, we plan to make guides on how to start with cryptocurrencies, integrate crypto wallet connections to our platform, and much more.

item3.title: Who could use the calculators and provided information?
item3.content: Everyone. Whether you want to compare salary conditions against the average wage, or see the difference between an employee's salary and a self-employed person. If you're interested in finance or would like to expand your horizons.

hero.title: Building Savings
hero.description: Understanding Stavebné Sporenie: A Central European Approach to Housing Finance

what_is.title: What is Building Savings?
what_is.description: Building savings (Stavebné sporenie) is a specialized savings and loan program designed to help people save for housing purposes. It combines regular savings with the possibility of obtaining a favorable housing loan, supported by state premiums.

origins.title: Origins
origins.description: The concept originated in Germany (Bausparen) and was adopted by Central European countries, becoming particularly popular in Slovakia and the Czech Republic after 1992.

popularity.title: Regional Popularity
popularity.description: Most common in: Germany, Austria, Slovakia, Czech Republic, Hungary, and Croatia. Less common or non-existent in other parts of Europe and the world.

state_premium.title: State Premium
state_premium.description: Annual state contribution up to €70 in Slovakia (varies by year and country). Premium is calculated as a percentage of annual savings.

interest.title: Guaranteed Interest
interest.description: Fixed interest rate on savings (typically 1-2%) plus state premium, making it more attractive than regular savings accounts.

loan.title: Housing Loan Option
loan.description: Right to apply for a favorable housing loan after the savings period, with better interest rates than standard mortgages.

savings_phase.title: Savings Phase
features: Regular monthly deposits (amount based on your contract)
Annual state premium added to your savings
Interest earned on both savings and state premiums

loan_phase.title: Loan Phase (Optional)
features: Option to apply for a housing loan
Favorable interest rates compared to standard mortgages
Loan amount based on saved amount and creditworthiness

optimize.title: Optimize Your Savings
items: Save the optimal amount to maximize state premium
